title: MxAgile Role Coverage Report
description: Structured role coverage assessment for a wave or discovery cycle. Located at planning/role-coverage/<wave-id>-role-coverage.yaml. Produced by the Discovery Agent and checked by Gate-to-Refinement and Acceptance Agent. See WP-09.

mockup_id.description: Design Contract mockup ID this coverage was derived from.

target_revision.description: REV-NNN of the active target mockup revision at the time of this assessment.

assessed_by.description: Agent or person who performed this assessment.

overall_status.description: Aggregate status. COVERED: all roles have at least COVERED status. COVERAGE_GAP: one or more roles have COVERAGE_GAP. PRESERVATION_FAILURE: a previously confirmed role was unexpectedly lost.

role_id.description: Stable role identifier from the Design Contract (e.g. ROLE-E3-EINTRAGUNG) or canonical role model.

contract_present.description: Role is present in the Design Contract roles[] array.

requirements_present.description: Role appears in at least one Requirement's target_users or acceptance_criteria.

runtime_present.description: Role has a usable demo identity or role-switcher mode in the executable mockup.

demo_mode_present.description: Role is selectable via demo Role Switcher or test identity in the mockup runtime.

representative_scope_present.description: For scoped roles: a representative scope context exists (e.g. a Center for E2, a Team for E4).

required_scope.description: Required scope type for this role: 'app', 'center', 'abteilung', 'team', or null for global roles.

ui_inventory_present.description: Role appears in at least one page YAML roles[] entry.

story_coverage_present.description: Role is covered in at least one Story-Spec.

task_coverage_present.description: Role is referenced in at least one Implementation Task or acceptance journey.

acceptance_coverage_present.description: Role is covered by at least one active Test Contract proof point.

status.description: COVERED: role is fachlich present, representable in mockup, has scope, has at least one acceptance journey. COVERAGE_GAP: role is fachlich confirmed but lacks testable identity, scope, story coverage, or journey. PRESERVATION_FAILURE: role was previously confirmed and has been unexpectedly removed.

gap_description.description: Human-readable description of the gap when status is COVERAGE_GAP or PRESERVATION_FAILURE.

evidence.description: References to evidence sources (Contract IDs, story IDs, test contract IDs, etc.).

notes.description: Optional notes about the overall coverage assessment.
